title: Annotatio VI §.II Number: Ternary principals — Supper, Person of Christ, Predestination; innumerable lesser
pass_a_gloss: It has a Number, as to the principal Controversies, a Ternary — or rather concerning three articles of Christian dogmas: first On the Sacred Supper; second, sprung from this, On the Person of Christ; and third finally added On Predestination; but as to the less Principal, an innumerable number, and one to be increased day by day by intemperate zeal, and sometimes even by the bare libido of the Authors.
pass_b_english: As to principal controversies the number is a ternary: first the Sacred Supper; then, sprung from it, the Person of Christ; and third, Predestination.
The lesser ones are countless, and they grow daily by intemperate zeal — sometimes by bare authorial whim.
source_text: Numerum habet, quà principales Controversias, Ternarium, seu tres potiùs dogmatum Christianorum articulos concernentem: De S. Coenâ primum; alterum, ex hoc enatum, de Persona Christi, tandemque adjectum tertium de Praedestinatione; Quà minus Principales, innumerum, & pro intempestivo zelo, quandoque etiam pro nuda Autorum libidine, indies augendum.

lemmas.gloss: to be increased day by day

notes: Ternarium: Coena, Persona Christi, Praedestinatio; innumerable lesser.
